description: LINHA METRÔ BELO HORIZONTE is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
